input.issue:
pipx list --json can print non-json to stdout
When nothing is installed, `pipx list --json` prints `nothing has been installed with pipx 😴` to stdout, and that's not valid json.

_Originally posted by @liskin in https://github.com/pipxproject/pipx/issues/660#issuecomment-828473735_

In addition, any warnings about the venvs are also printed to stdout, which is also non-valid json!

setup: python -c 'import base64; from pathlib import Path; Path('"'"'/tmp/receipts-pipxproject__pipx-680-test.patch'"'"').write_bytes(base64.b64decode('"'"''"'"'))'

plan.approach: Check whether `--json` flag is used during listing; if so, direct messages like "nothing has been installed" or validation warnings to stderr instead of stdout, ensuring clean JSON on stdout.
plan.hypothesis: Correct output routing for JSON listing mode.
